This is a well-specified quantitative reasoning task with a single correct answer, so I prioritized raw capability. Curlew-235B has clearly stronger benchmarks across the board (MMLU-Pro 80.3 vs 75.9, GPQA Diamond 62.5 vs 56.2, IFEval 90.4 vs 85.3), and the user's explicit concern about arithmetic accuracy makes capability the decisive factor.

Willet's documentation notes a preference for extraction/reformatting tasks, but this isn't a retrieval task—it requires careful expected-value computation—and crucially, those are self-reported preferences with no demonstrated effect on output quality. So preference doesn't tip the balance; measured capability does, and that favors Curlew.

ROUTE: Curlew-235B
